summary: A cylindrical pressurised space-station module about 10 m long: a lathed barrel with conical end bulkheads in… joints fwd_hatch, array_l, array_r, radiator, dish_pan; sockets socket_dock_fwd, socket_dock_aft, socket_grapple, eye_point.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.space_station_module or place "prefab": "space_station_module" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
